title: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
field: Health research, natural sciences and engineering, social sciences and humanities
description: Prestigious doctoral scholarship to attract and retain world-class doctoral students at Canadian universities, assessed on academic excellence, research potential and leadership. Students cannot apply directly; a Canadian university must nominate the candidate.
amount: CAD 50,000 per year for three years

title: Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships
description: Fellowships to support the very best postdoctoral researchers, both nationally and internationally, who will contribute to Canada's economic, social and research-based growth. Applications are submitted jointly with a Canadian host institution.
amount: CAD 70,000 per year for two years

title: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Doctoral Scholarships
description: Scholarships for outstanding doctoral candidates in the humanities and social sciences working on themes related to public policy and pressing societal issues, with an engagement and mentorship programme alongside the funding.
amount: Up to CAD 40,000 per year plus a CAD 25,000 annual travel and networking allowance, for up to four years

title: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
description: The University of Toronto's most prestigious undergraduate award for international students, recognising exceptional academic achievement and creativity, and students who are recognised as leaders within their school. Candidates must be nominated by their school.
amount: Full tuition, books, incidental fees and residence support for four years

title: International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES)
description: Merit-based entrance scholarships for outstanding international undergraduate students entering UBC directly from secondary school, considered automatically for most applicants who submit a complete application by the award deadline.
amount: CAD 10,000 to CAD 25,000 per year, renewable for up to four years

title: Ontario Trillium Scholarship (OTS)
description: Scholarship for the best international doctoral students to study at a participating university in Ontario. Each university administers its own competition and nominates recipients; applicants apply for admission to a doctoral programme and are considered by the graduate unit.
amount: CAD 40,000 per year for up to four years

title: McCall MacBain Scholarships at McGill
field: All fields (full-time master's or professional degrees)
description: Canada's first comprehensive leadership scholarship for master's and professional studies, pairing full funding with a leadership programme, mentorship and coaching. Open to applicants of any nationality.
amount: Full tuition and fees plus a living stipend; partial awards also offered

title: IDRC Research Awards
field: International development, economics, health, environment, governance
description: Paid one-year research positions at IDRC for master's and doctoral students and recent graduates, offering hands-on experience in research management and grant administration alongside their own field research.
amount: Paid salary plus research and travel allowances for one year

title: York University International Student Scholarship Program
description: Renewable entrance scholarships for high-achieving international undergraduate students, ranging from a set annual amount up to the full cost of tuition for the most outstanding applicants.
amount: CAD 20,000 up to full tuition per year, renewable for up to four years
